processing: Original PNGs copied unchanged into source. Python only reads alpha and writes bounding-box/JSON manifests. Godot performs atlas slicing, common per-sheet scale, transparent canvas alignment and portrait cropping. No mirroring, repaint, crossfade synthesis or per-frame scale normalization.
quality_boundary: Four distinct painted frames per requested direction/state with leg silhouette variation. The repeated contact poses remain close and the loops are stylized four-frame cycles, not polished eight-frame motion capture. Runtime assist-state/scale/interaction QA belongs to the main integration task. Damingfu rescue walk cycles remain unmade.
